prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a warm editorial portrait of an adult woman with long blonde hair and bangs in a cozy cluttered mystical room. She wears an oversized charcoal-gray T-shirt and kneels on a plush textured green rug, resting her elbows and chin on a tall stack of vintage books while looking at the camera with a gentle smile. The book spines may read Magic and the Supernatural, Folklore, and Witchcraft. Behind her, forest-green walls hold wooden shelves filled with glass bottles, small lights, plants, dried herbs, crystals, a globe, and vintage books. Include a hanging glass lamp and warm string lights. Use soft warm ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, high-quality photographic realism, and a cozy mysterious atmosphere.
